evidence.decision: Chooses columns for deep bidirectional traversal without attribute sorting and defines ancestor changes that invalidate descendant/preview identity.
evidence.artifact: Requires a root/parent/leaf selection-to-column contract, width policy and meaningful preview contents.
evidence.transformation: Asset browser replaces stale last-folder entry/leaf preview with visible root-first ancestry and recomputed downstream columns.
evidence.verification: Traverses siblings/root/leaves and resizes long names; fails detached descendants, incorrect preview identity or absent root route.
evidence.applicability: Explicitly macOS-only; evaluates supported split-view adaptation elsewhere without equating framework availability with HIG support.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Outline views for sorted attributes and Split views for cross-platform hierarchy/detail coordination.
evidence.distinctiveness: Column creation/clearing and leaf-preview identity are consequential browser behaviors beyond generic layout advice.
